none: PAS CAM-6F25C9: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Theodosius - VICTO[RIA AVGGG].
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 388-402 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads VICTO[RIA AVGGG]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Mint is Lyon. Obverse legend reads DN [...]. Obverse shows an unclear laureate or diademed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //LVGP. Die axis is 6 o'clock.
